snippet.title: Reveal Trailer | Reaper Actual
snippet.description:
Another beautiful day in Marova. Witness the reveal of Reaper Actual: a persistent, open-world where Reapers battle for mercenary contracts, gear extraction and upgrades, as well as manage unique bases to defend from raiding player squads. As players engage with the living island, watch as it changes around them, reacting to their choices. It's only the beginning.

Visit https://www.reaperactual.com for more info.

About Reaper Actual:
Reaper Actual is a first person, open-world persistent shooter with an extraction gameplay loop. Set on the living island of Marova - a nation scarred by civil war and abandoned civilians. Players become Reapers, fallen Tier-1 operators who now contract with warring factions, carve out territory, and extract coveted resources back to their own upgradable bases.
